report_title: Warehouse Cooling Failure - Overnight Incident Brief
executive_summary: A compressor starter failed in Zone B cold storage overnight, driving temperatures above threshold for 72 minutes. The team stabilized the room with a rental chiller before any customer orders shipped, but inbound receiving paused and 14 pallets require a morning quality hold review.

timeline.event: Temperature alarms triggered in Zone B cold storage.
Facilities isolated the failed compressor and began manual venting.
Inventory control paused chilled inbound receiving and started spoilage checks.
Rental chiller arrived on site and room temperature returned below 4C.
Incident commander approved a morning quality hold for the affected pallets.

actions.action: Replace the failed compressor starter and complete redundancy validation.
Finish QA inspection for 14 held pallets and release sellable inventory.
Issue customer comms template in case outbound delays exceed two hours.
Publish root-cause review agenda and assign attendees for the 48-hour review.
